title: Design System: 小说转剧本工作台

display.purpose: Screenplay title; loudest type, capped near 26-29px.

title.purpose: Centered shooting-script scene headings, wide tracking.

label.purpose: Mono panel headers, meta, badges, confidence readouts.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for panels; barely-there raise.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover-only lift for character cards, paired with translateY(-3px).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions, hover, and reveals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committed action (load sample, start conversion).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', serif; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 9px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #b23a30; background: #b23a30; color: #f7ede0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8f2c25; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8f2c25; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action on the panel toolbar.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', serif; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 9px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d8cfbd; background: #fbf8f1; color: #211b16; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.16s, transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-default:hover { border-color: #8c8071; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b23a30; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Chip
components.description: Stat / count pill; accent variant for emphasis, warn variant for open questions.
components.html: 7 场 2 待确认
components.css: .ds-chip-accent { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #b23a30; color: #b23a30; background: rgba(178,58,48,0.10); } .ds-chip-warn { font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #a6802f; color: #a6802f; background: rgba(166,128,47,0.10); }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.description: Output view switcher on the recessed paper strip; active tab carries the only underline accent.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 0 8px; background: #efe8d8; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8cfbd; } .ds-tab { appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', serif; font-size: 14px; color: #8c8071; padding: 14px 16px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; transition: color 0.18s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #211b16; } .ds-tab--active { color: #211b16; font-weight: 700; border-bottom-color: #b23a30; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b23a30; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab-n { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10.5px; color: #b23a30; margin-left: 6px; }

components.name: Character Card
components.description: Flat at rest, rises on hover; carries a role badge and confidence meter.
components.html:
沈砚主角

书院里沉默寡言的抄经人，握有半枚旧印。
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; border: 1px solid #d8cfbd; border-radius: 11px; padding: 18px; background: #f4efe4; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(33,27,22,0.07), 0 20px 50px -20px rgba(33,27,22,0.3); } .ds-card-name { font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-role { position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #b23a30; color: #f7ede0; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.8; color: #4a4036; margin: 12px 0; } .ds-meter { display: flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-meter i { width: 16px; height: 5px; border-radius: 2px; background: #d8cfbd; } .ds-meter i.on { background: #5a6f5a; }

components.name: Novel Textarea
components.description: Borderless writing surface that sits directly on the panel paper.
components.css: .ds-input-frame { border: 1px solid #d8cfbd; border-radius: 12px; background: #fbf8f1; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 0.18s; } .ds-input-frame:focus-within { border-color: #b23a30; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(178,58,48,0.25); } .ds-novel { display: block; width: 100%; border: 0; outline: none; resize: vertical; background: transparent; min-height: 160px; padding: 16px 18px; font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.95; color: #211b16; } .ds-novel::placeholder { color: #6b5f50; }

narrative.overview: A working manuscript desk rendered in software: warm rice-paper surface, a Chinese serif set for long-form reading, and a single vermilion correction seal used the way a senior editor uses a red pen, sparingly and only where it carries meaning. Everything serves one act: reading a generated screenplay and marking it up with confidence. The system is literary, trustworthy, and effortless; it earns its cultural character through restraint, not costume. Color does real work: cinnabar means emphasis, jade means faithful/passed, gold means inferred/low-confidence.
keyCharacteristics: Rice-paper warmth with a single vermilion accent; everything else is ink and hairline.
Semantic color: cinnabar = emphasis, jade = faithful, gold = inferred.
Serif-led long-form reading type; mono reserved for the machine voice.
Refined and restrained surfaces; depth appears only on interaction.
The generated screenplay is always the hero; chrome recedes to the margins.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: Cinnabar is the only saturated accent on any screen and stays under ~10% of the surface. Jade and gold are semantic signals, not decoration.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: The serif does all reading work across weights 400-900. Do not add a second serif or sans; mono is the functional machine voice, not a display face.

rules.name: The Brush-Is-A-Seal Rule
rules.body: Ma Shan Zheng is confined to the 60px brand seal glyph. Never set headings, labels, or body in brush script.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Layering is done with paper tones and hairlines first, shadow second. Shadows never stack and never go darker than the Lift token.

dos: Do keep cinnabar as the single accent under ~10% of any screen.
Do use jade for faithful/passed and gold for inferred/low-confidence semantically.
Do carry all reading type in one serif across weights 400-900; reserve mono for labels, meta, YAML, code.
Do build structure from hairline rules and paper tone steps before reaching for a shadow.
Do cap screenplay reading blocks at 40ch (dialogue) to 62-75ch (prose).
Do add visible :focus-visible to every button, tab, and the textarea, plus a prefers-reduced-motion alternative for spinners, pulse dots, hover lifts, and reveals.
Do darken ink-faint toward the ink end wherever it carries body or placeholder text until it clears 4.5:1.
donts: Don't ship a generic SaaS dashboard: no blue accent, no uniform icon+heading card grid, no Inter-everywhere template.
Don't drift into skeuomorphic kitsch: no faux torn paper, dragon motifs, ancient-scroll clichés, or brush script outside the seal glyph.
Don't clutter: no dense toolbars, no second saturated accent competing with cinnabar, no noise that pulls the eye off the script.
Don't round cards or panels above 16px, and don't pair a 1px border with a wide soft drop-shadow on the same element.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right stripe as an accent; use full borders, background tint, or a leading mark.
Don't strip focus outlines without an equal-or-better replacement.
Don't set ink-faint gray text on tinted paper for anything a reader must actually read.
